rationales.rules-based-checks-v3: CI-integrated SAST, software-composition analysis (SCA), and license scanners deterministically check AI-generated diffs for security vulnerabilities, risky dependencies, and licensing violations; high-risk findings block merge.

flags.issue: TESTS: unit, edge-case, and integration tests; AUTHOR: unclear — LLMs propose tests for AI-assisted code, but the paper does not establish whether the same model produced both the code and its tests.
